title: Publish Item Payload
description: Cross-module contract for data/publish_export/<language_code>/items/<slug>.json. Mirrors modules/publish/docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md Section 6.1 and EXECUTION_POLICY.md Section 7.2 after the translation label leakage refactor: structured content fields (summary_short + semantic bullets) replace the monolithic content field, and presentation UI labels must not appear in exported values.

summary_short.description: Passed through from translation_output.summary_short; must remain non-empty after trimming whitespace. Single summary source for item, index, and archive entries.

not.pattern: ^[\s*_-]*(Key Claim|Evidence Level|Objective Impact|主要な主張|主要主張|關鍵主張|核心主張|主張の要点|證據層級|證據等級|証拠の水準|証拠レベル|証拠水準|エビデンスレベル|客観的な影響|客観的影響|客觀影響|實際影響|目的上の影響)[\s*_]*[:：]

bullets.description: Required on every item JSON and never omitted. Exactly two valid shapes: for downstream_action 'publish_summary' an object with exactly the keys key_claim, evidence_level, objective_impact (each a trim-non-empty string); for downstream_action 'publish_link' JSON null. Empty objects and partial key sets are never valid.

author_metadata.description: Always exported as a structured object (deserialized from the canonical TEXT column). Requires source_module (a string that remains non-empty after trimming) and writer_type; human/hybrid writer types additionally require an editor field under the same trim-non-empty string rule.
